name: Dawit I
contribution: Emperor of Ethiopia from 1382 until his death on October 6, 1413, and a member of the Solomonic dynasty.

checks.lead: Dawit I (Ge'ez: ዳዊት; throne name Qwestantinos) was Emperor of Ethiopia from 1382 until his death on October 6, 1413, and a member of the Solomonic dynasty.
